description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for managing performance tracker data, including retrieving the DAO (Data Access Object) and updating performance tracker records, with permission checks. It interacts with external classes such as PerformanceTracker, PerformanceTrackerDao, and PerformanceTrackerServiceException.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerService
classes.description: Service class for handling performance tracker operations, such as updating performance tracker records and managing DAO access with lazy initialization.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerDao
methods.description: Returns the PerformanceTrackerDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: updateTracker
methods.description: Updates a performance tracker record after verifying if the tracker owner is editable; throws exception if not.
